text_en: Job again took up his discourse and said:
text_cn: 约伯继续他的言论说：

text_en: “O that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
text_cn: 谁能赐我似以前的岁月，像以往天主护守我的时日呢？

text_en: when his lamp shone over my head, and by his light I walked through darkness;
text_cn: 那时他的灯，光照在我头上，藉他的光明，我走过黑暗。

text_en: when I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was upon my tent;
text_cn: 惟愿我如壮年之时，那时天主护佑我的帐幕；

text_en: when the Almighty was still with me, when my children were around me;
text_cn: 全能者与我相偕，我的子女环绕着我；

text_en: when my steps were washed with milk, and the rock poured out for me streams of oil!
text_cn: 那时我以奶油洗脚，崖石流油成河。

text_en: When I went out to the gate of the city, when I took my seat in the square,
text_cn: 当我走出城门，在市井设我座位之时，

text_en: the young men saw me and withdrew, and the aged rose up and stood;
text_cn: 少年人看见我都回避，老年人都起身站立；

text_en: the nobles refrained from talking, and laid their hands on their mouths;
text_cn: 王侯停止讲话，用手堵住自己的口；

text_en: the voices of princes were hushed, and their tongues stuck to the roof of their mouths.
text_cn: 首领不敢出声，舌头紧贴上颚。

text_en: When the ear heard, it commended me, and when the eye saw, it approved;
text_cn: 凡有耳听见我的，必称我有福；凡有眼看见我的，都必称赞我。

text_en: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the orphan who had no helper.
text_cn: 因为我援助了呼救的穷人，和无依无靠的孤儿。

text_en: The blessing of the wretched came upon me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
text_cn: 那受丧亡之痛的人称谢我，我使寡妇的心欢乐。

text_en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; my justice was like a robe and a turban.
text_cn: 我披上正义，正义就如我衣；我的公正，犹如我的长袍和冠冕。

text_en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
text_cn: 我作了盲人的眼，跛者的脚。

text_en: I was a father to the needy, and I championed the cause of the stranger.
text_cn: 我成了穷人之父，我调查过素不相识者的案件。

text_en: I broke the fangs of the unrighteous, and made them drop their prey from their teeth.
text_cn: 我打碎恶人的獠牙，由他牙齿中夺出了猎物。

text_en: Then I thought, ‘I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days like the phoenix;
text_cn: 我心想：我必寿终正寝，我的寿数必如尘沙。

text_en: my roots spread out to the waters, with the dew all night on my branches;
text_cn: 我的根蔓延到水边，夜间甘露落在我的枝叶上。

text_en: my glory was fresh with me, and my bow ever new in my hand. ’
text_cn: 我的荣耀不断更新，我手中的弓日新月异。

text_en: “They listened to me, and waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
text_cn: 听我讲话的人，屏息等待，静听我的指教。

text_en: After I spoke they did not speak again, and my word dropped upon them like dew.
text_cn: 我讲话之后，无人再敢讲话，我的话像水珠滴在他们身上。

text_en: They waited for me as for the rain; they opened their mouths as for the spring rain.
text_cn: 他们期待我如望甘霖，张着大口如渴盼春雨。

text_en: I smiled on them when they had no confidence; and the light of my countenance they did not extinguish.
text_cn: 我向他们微笑，他们不敢相信；我和善的面容，他们必不放过。

text_en: I chose their way, and sat as chief, and I lived like a king among his troops, like one who comforts mourners.
text_cn: 我为他们选择了道路，身居前导，一如立在军中的君王；我引他们到那里，他们就去。
